tools.name: search_creators
tools.description: Find Creator records on the Open Creator Graph by name, handle, SPRK ID or profile URL. Returns each match's SPRK ID, name, handle, platforms, claim state and record URL. Use it before get_creator_record when you only know a name or handle.

tools.name: get_creator_record
tools.description: Read one Creator's full public record as Markdown: their accounts on each platform with follower or subscriber counts (as ranges) and the date seen, content topics, location, languages, how long they have been active, and, where published, occupation, representation, website, credentials and notable

tools.name: get_ai_consent
tools.description: What a Creator allows AI to do with their name, image, likeness, voice, movement and signature, in words, with links to the machine-readable HCS 1.0 declaration. A record with no declaration has set no terms: treat that as unknown, never as permission.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_creator_record" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
